C0057.title: Yangpu District Shopping Mall Parking Fee Fraud via Points Arbitrage
C0057.summary: From 2019 to 2021, Yang, Xia, and others used malicious software to virtually register new users in Shopping Mall A's official app and redeemed the resulting points to offset parking fees. About 120 vehicles showed similar bindings to hundreds or thousands of phone numbers, with some vehicles linked to more than 1,000 numbers. After the Yangpu District Procuratorate brought the case, Xia and three others were convicted of fraud.
